metadata.title: Beef Trotters Soup | Northeastern Style
metadata.description:
Beef trotter soup is a rustic Northeastern recipe, where cow trotters are slow cooked with earthy ingredients for a very long time. The result is a delicious melt in you mouth gelatinous  goodness and a very delicious and healthy soup.
